## Meet Quarto

Quarto combines narrative written in Markdown with executable code and its
results. Rendering this source document runs the Python cells and produces a
finished PDF.

## Meet the Palmer penguins

```{python}
#| label: load-penguins
#| include: false

from plotnine import aes, geom_point, ggplot, labs, theme_minimal
from plotnine.data import penguins

complete_penguins = penguins.dropna(
    subset=["bill_length_mm", "flipper_length_mm", "species"]
)
```

The `penguins` data bundled with
[plotnine](https://plotnine.org/reference/penguins.html) contains measurements
for `{python} len(penguins)` penguins from three species observed in the Palmer
Archipelago, Antarctica.

## Compare two measurements

The relationship between bill length and flipper length differs across the
three species. See @fig-penguins for the measurements used in this small
example.

```{python}
#| label: fig-penguins
#| fig-cap: "Bill length and flipper length for three Palmer penguin species."
#| fig-alt: "Scatterplot of bill length against flipper length, with points colored by penguin species."
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 4.5

(
    ggplot(
        complete_penguins,
        aes("bill_length_mm", "flipper_length_mm", color="species"),
    )
    + geom_point(alpha=0.75, size=2)
    + labs(x="Bill length (mm)", y="Flipper length (mm)", color="Species")
    + theme_minimal()
)
```
